annotation.title_clean: H.R. 1186 – Curbing Realistic Exploitative Electronic Pedophilic Robots Act 2.0 (CREEPER Act 2.0)
annotation.title_en: H.R. 1186 – Curbing Realistic Exploitative Electronic Pedophilic Robots Act 2.0 (CREEPER Act 2.0)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. House of Representatives (Rep. Buchanan and Rep. Moskowitz)
annotation.summary_en: US House bill (CREEPER Act 2.0) introduced February 2025 to amend Title 18, banning importation, transportation and trafficking of child sex dolls, defined to include anatomically correct dolls, mannequins or robots resembling minors. It sets criminal penalties of up to five years for a first offense and ten years for each later offense.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines 'child sex doll' to include dolls, mannequins or robots with minor-like features intended for sexual acts
Amends 18 U.S.C. 1462 to prohibit importation or interstate transportation of child sex dolls
Creates new 18 U.S.C. 1471 criminalizing buying, selling, distributing and possessing with intent to traffic
Penalties: up to 5 years first offense, up to 10 years for subsequent offenses
Congressional findings link such dolls and robots to child exploitation and normalization of abuse
